detail.title: Journal Entry: Portfolio Rebalancing for Capacity Compliance
detail.summary: To maintain operational adherence to capacity constraints while responding to topic enforcement requirements, we have parked the active research into obedience limits. This action reduces the active project load and clears the path for future topic alignment, while ongoing work in research question abandonment and reasoning limits proceeds within established parameters.
